text:
maya (PM): short sync: private preview plan. 12 seats. need tracks, selection rubric, onboarding checklist, rollback triggers. want to ship invites next Monday.

jon (GTM): two tracks ok: full (6w) and short (3w). reserve 2 slots for case studies.

sara (CS): incentives: full = credits + 6h solutions time; short = credits + templates. include co-marketing only for case studies.

nate (Eng): ops constraint: safe concurrency ~7. suggest wave A/B with 4-4 and 2 reserve. schedule waves 2 weeks apart.

maya (PM): good. screening questions: primary use case, expected tokens/day, data sensitivity, success metric.

claire (Legal): flag about sample data and DPA addendum. add short line in invite about data handling and rollback rights.

nate (Eng): rollback triggers proposal: sustained error rate >4% for 24h, latency >2x baseline p50 for 6h, confirmed data leak. auto-alert + ops review 2h.

sara (CS): onboarding checklist draft: token access, dataset sample, baseline eval, observability hook, calendar invite. put this in invite.

devex-bot: poll created "kickoff cadence" options weekly30, biweekly60, weekly15 (48h).

maya (PM): actions: jon -> outreach + form by Wed, sara -> incentives + FAQ, nate -> wave schedule + alerts, claire -> DPA snippet. I'll compile invites Fri. :thumbsup:
